Security._comment: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection on sign-in. Leave both blank to keep it OFF (LAN-only installs need nothing). Set both from your Cloudflare Turnstile dashboard to challenge logins that arrive over the public tunnel.

Gemini._comment: Signature auto-detection on the Document Checklist (#6). Leave ApiKey blank to keep it OFF (the 'Signed' tick stays manual). Set the key out-of-file via env var Gemini__ApiKey or user-secrets — do not commit a real key here.

ApiBilling._comment: Postpaid provider-API billing. GraceDays = days after month-end the client has to pay before API use is paused; GstPct is added on top of the (ex-GST) Digio rates.
